evals.prompt: aggiungi un todo: 'Rispondere all'email del cliente Rossi riguardo il preventivo'. Priorità alta, scade oggi.
evals.expected_output: Crea Todos/active/2026-06-17_rispondere-all-email-del-cliente-rossi.md con YAML frontmatter corretto (status: pending, priority: high, due_date: oggi), sezioni Task Details/Checklist/Execution Log, aggiorna README files. La validazione deve passare.
expectations: A .md file is created inside Todos/active/ with a slug-based filename
The YAML frontmatter contains 'status: pending', 'priority: high', and 'due_date: 2026-06-17'
The file contains sections '## Task Details', '## Checklist', '## Execution Log'
The Checklist section has at least one unchecked item '- [ ]'
Todos/active/README.md is updated with an entry for this todo
Todos/README.md contains a 'Recent Changes' section with this todo
The validation script reports the file as valid

evals.prompt: add todo: 'Set up CI/CD pipeline for the backend repo'. No specific deadline, medium priority.
evals.expected_output: Creates Todos/active/YYYY-MM-DD_set-up-ci-cd-pipeline-for-the-backend-repo.md with priority: medium and NO due_date field in frontmatter.
expectations: A .md file is created inside Todos/active/
The YAML frontmatter contains 'priority: medium'
The YAML frontmatter does NOT contain a 'due_date' field (no deadline)
The file contains a '## Checklist' section with at least one item
Todos/active/README.md entry shows 'none' as due date

evals.prompt: I need to remember to review the quarterly budget report by end of this week.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers on implicit phrasing, creates todo with title about budget review, due date end of week (2026-06-21), and creates Todos/ structure if missing.
expectations: A todo file is created (skill triggered from implicit phrasing without 'add todo')
The todo title relates to 'quarterly budget report'
The due_date is set to 2026-06-21 (end of this week)
Full Todos/ directory structure is created (RULE.md, README.md, active/, completed/)

evals.prompt: Aggiorna il todo 'Fix login bug': cambia la priorità a medium e aggiungi la scadenza a domani (2026-06-18).
evals.expected_output: Trova il file fix-login-bug in Todos/active/, aggiorna priority: medium e due_date: 2026-06-18 nel frontmatter, aggiunge entry nell'Execution Log. La validazione deve passare.
expectations: The existing todo file is found and modified (not a new file created)
The YAML frontmatter is updated: priority changes to 'medium'
The YAML frontmatter is updated: due_date is set to '2026-06-18'
An entry is added to '## Execution Log' documenting the changes
The validation script reports the updated file as valid

evals.prompt: Segna come completato il todo 'Fix login bug'.
evals.expected_output: Trova fix-login-bug in Todos/active/, aggiorna status: done, aggiunge completed_at, sposta in Todos/completed/, aggiorna entrambi i README.
expectations: The todo file is moved from Todos/active/ to Todos/completed/
The YAML frontmatter contains 'status: done'
The YAML frontmatter contains a 'completed_at' field with today's date
An entry is added to '## Execution Log' noting completion
Todos/active/README.md no longer contains an entry for this todo
Todos/README.md 'Recent Changes' section mentions the completion
